description: Validates the check digits of an 11-digit Turkish national identity number (T.C. Kimlik Numarası, TCKN), which individuals also use as their tax number. The number is personal data: it is not echoed back. It does not confirm the person exists. Format and checksum only: a valid result does not prove the number is registered or belongs to anyone. Inputs are not stored or logged.
name: validate_national_id
title: Validate a Turkish national ID number (TCKN)
